cover_letter.greeting: Dear Citi Energy Corporate Banking Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Energy Corporate Banking Analyst role in Houston. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Energy is the sector I want to build a career in, and corporate banking is a good place to learn how energy companies fund themselves and how a bank decides where to put its capital.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation, built models to evaluate $10M in spend, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership. In my MBA coursework I built a DCF, comps and an LBO for J.M. Smucker.
That maps to organizing data for client proposals, running financial performance evaluations, and writing clear recommendations for senior bankers. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Energy Corporate Banking Analyst role in Houston. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I've built DCF, comps and LBO models in my MBA coursework. I'd love to hear how the energy coverage team works. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
